title: NCLEX Prioritization and Delegation Practice Questions
description: Practice management of care with nursing prioritization, delegation, and communication questions. Read a sample rationale, then start a focused review.
intro: Work through decisions about who needs attention, which tasks can be delegated, and how information moves between members of the care team.
approach: For each scenario, identify what has changed, who is responsible for the decision, and what information is still needed. Compare your reasoning with the rationale, not just the answer letter.
sourceLabel: NCSBN and ANA: National Guidelines for Nursing Delegation

title: NCLEX Safety and Infection Control Practice Questions
description: Review NCLEX safety and infection control questions with rationales, including standard precautions, protective equipment, and prevention of care-related harm.
intro: Review how nurses recognize avoidable hazards and choose precautions that fit the care being provided.
approach: Separate the precautions used for routine care from those required for a particular exposure. Read the setting and task carefully before selecting an intervention.
sourceLabel: CDC: Standard Precautions for All Patient Care

title: NCLEX Health Promotion and Maintenance Practice Questions
description: Study health promotion and maintenance with NCLEX-style questions on prevention, family education, and healthy development. Includes a sample answer explanation.
intro: Practice explaining preventive care and helping clients and families make informed choices across the lifespan.
approach: Notice the client's age, circumstances, and learning needs. Look for teaching that addresses the specific situation rather than advice that only sounds generally healthy.
sourceLabel: NICHD Safe to Sleep: Safe Sleep Environment

title: NCLEX Mental Health and Psychosocial Integrity Questions
description: Practice psychosocial integrity questions about therapeutic communication, mental health, and safety assessment, with explanations for correct and incorrect answers.
intro: Build confidence reading conversations and choosing responses that support communication while recognizing immediate safety concerns.
approach: Read what the client actually says. Compare responses for whether they invite an honest answer, address the concern, or dismiss it. Review why a reassuring-sounding option may not answer the question.
sourceLabel: NIMH: 5 Action Steps to Help Someone Having Thoughts of Suicide

title: NCLEX Physiological Integrity Practice Questions
description: Review physiological integrity with NCLEX-style questions on physical assessment, treatment responses, and changes in condition. Practice with answer rationales.
intro: Connect assessment findings with the next nursing action in scenarios involving physical care and treatment responses.
approach: Identify the relevant findings, the client's current abilities, and any orders or protocols stated in the question. After checking the answer, explain why the other actions do not fit this situation.
